en.text:
Casting your Rift grants a 'Void Soul' for 25 seconds. 

Weapon Hits send the <void/>Void Soul towards the target's location, projecting a 10 meter radius <void/>Weakening field upon arrival that lasts for 9.25 seconds. Void Soul continously deals damage and applies <void/>Weaken every 0.7 seconds. The <void/> Weaken lasts for <pve 4 /> <pvp [2.5] /> seconds after its last application. For the first <pve 4 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds of being tethered, targets are <void/>Suppressed as well.

If you have Healing Rift equipped, the <void/>Void Soul grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every other tick. If you have Empowering Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 25 HP every other tick.

//Chunks scalars? Fixed?

Defeating targets within <void/>Void Soul's radius grant Class Ability Energy based on <link Combatant Tier [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1: 10%
• Tier 2: 15%
• Tier 3: 20%
• Tier 4 or 5: 50%
• Players: 33.3%

Void Soul counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.
